remarks: Offers Monday 4/27 by 4pm. See agent remarks. Nestled in Norwalk's coveted Saugatuck area, 29 Old Saugatuck Rd offers charm, functionality, and an unbeatable lifestyle. Directly across from the picturesque Shore Haven Golf Course, this home boasts serene views and lush greenery. Inside, a practical mudroom welcomes you, leading to a warm living room with a wood-burning fireplace-perfect for cozy nights or casual gatherings. Adjacent is a bright, private home office, ideal for remote work or creative escapes. The modern kitchen, outfitted with sleek stainless steel appliances, flows seamlessly into an expansive space for dining and a cozy family room, designed for entertaining or everyday comfort.  Upstairs, you'll find three inviting bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with its own private ensuite bathroom, creating a perfect retreat at the end of the day. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath offer flexibility for family, guests, or even a hobby space-each bathed in natural light and designed with comfort in mind.  Step outside to a delightful back patio, perfect for al fresco dining or summer barbecues, complemented by a charming vegetable garden and a stylish, functional shed for extra storage.
